seasons.name: Summer Solstice 2026
seasons.description: Lunar South Pole southern summer maximum (sub-solar latitude near -1.57 deg; peak illumination across high polar rims).

seasons.name: Equinox 2027
seasons.description: Lunar South Pole equinox window centered on the 2027-02-11 equatorial Sun crossing (0 deg sub-solar latitude).

seasons.name: Winter Solstice 2027
seasons.description: Lunar South Pole southern winter minimum centered on 2027-04-25 (sub-solar latitude near +1.56 deg; maximum polar shadowing).

sites.name: Shackleton Rim
sites.description: High-illumination crest on the rim of Shackleton Crater (Mazarico Site 4 vicinity), offering prolonged southern summer sunlight adjacent to permanently shadowed crater interiors.

sites.name: Malapert Massif
sites.description: Prominent Earth-facing summit massif on the South Pole-Aitken basin rim (~5.2 km elevation) providing high Direct-to-Earth communications uptime.

sites.name: Nobile Rim 1
sites.description: Elevated highland massif along the western rim of Nobile Crater, combining high solar illumination with access to volatile-rich polar crater margins.

sites.name: Connecting Ridge
sites.description: Elevated ridge linking Shackleton and de Gerlache craters with an unobstructed negative-angle horizon across all azimuths.

sites.name: Peak Near Shackleton
sites.description: High-standing polar massif neighboring Shackleton Crater with favorable grazing-angle solar visibility.

sites.name: Deep Crater Floor
sites.description: Permanently shadowed floor point inside Shackleton Crater located ~5.0 km from Shackleton Rim, demonstrating extreme terrain occlusion and total absence of direct sunlight and Earth DTE.
